output_list.reason: The 'mintToken' function has an integer overflow attack vulnerability. When 'mintedAmount' is a large value, the 'totalSupply' += 'mintedAmount' operation can cause integer overflow and become very unstable, allowing the owner to arbitrarily increase the balance of any user.

The 'transfer' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'balanceOf[_from]' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[_from] -= _value' operation can cause integer overflow and become very unstable, preventing further token transactions.

The 'burnFrom' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When '_value' is a large value, the 'balanceOf[target] -= _value' operation can cause integer overflow and become very unstable, allowing the owner to arbitrarily decrease any user's token balance.

The 'setPrices' function has an integer overflow vulnerability. When 'msg.value' is a large value, the 'msg.value / buyPrice' operation can cause integer overflow and become very unstable, allowing an attacker to make the buyPrice very large, causing unexpected outcomes in buy() function.
